title: LibreOffice managed settings
description: Per-user LibreOffice metadata-stripping settings. Applied via XCU merge at activation time.

removePersonalInfoOnSave.description: Strip author name, timestamps, editing duration, and other personal metadata from document properties when saving.

clearUserProfileData.description: Clear all user identity fields (name, email, company, etc.) from LibreOffice's user profile so metadata is never embedded.

extraSettings.description: Additional XCU entries to merge, beyond the built-in metadata-stripping defaults.
